set_up: Set up by your Razorpay account manager on 12 Sep 2026. In this demo it is read only.

sections.title: Alert door
sections.subtitle: How your alert tools send Blindspot what they see

rows.label: Your alert address
rows.note: One address for your account. Sentry, Datadog and PagerDuty send to it through an alert rule, with no change to your app.

rows.label: Signing
rows.value: Every alert must be signed with your signing secret. Unsigned alerts are refused.
rows.note: The signing secret is shown once, when you create it. Yours was created on 12 Sep.

rows.label: Counted as payments
rows.note: Your payment filter. Alerts from these services are checked against your payments.

rows.label: Left out since 24 Sep
rows.note: Alerts from any other service are dropped on arrival and never read.

rows.label: What is read from an alert
Never needed
rows.note: Fields like these are dropped before an alert is stored.

rows.label: Grouping
rows.value: Alerts about one cause within 10 minutes join one payment issue.
rows.note: So 200 alerts in a bad release are one issue, posted once.

rows.label: Match before acting
rows.value: An alert stays unconfirmed until Razorpay's payment data shows customers were hit. An alert alone is never acted on.

sections.title: Shared Slack channel
sections.subtitle: Where root causes and approvals reach your team

rows.label: Channel
rows.note: Blindspot posts only here, never in a channel you did not pick.

rows.label: Who is in it
rows.value: Your payments and on-call teams, your Razorpay account manager and Razorpay support.

rows.label: What is posted
list: A root cause, as a thread
Approval requests for refunds, order lists and messages
A closing note when an issue is fixed

rows.label: Who can approve
rows.note: Approve buttons work only for these roles. Everyone else in the channel can read.

rows.label: Razorpay support sign-off
rows.value: A Razorpay support engineer signs off every root cause. One that is only likely waits for that sign-off before it is posted.
